description: This PHP class 'ECB' in the Opencart admin extension handles currency exchange rate updates from the European Central Bank (ECB). It includes methods for displaying the currency configuration page, saving settings, and fetching/updating currency rates via an external XML feed.

classes.name: ECB
classes.description: Controller class for managing currency exchange rates from ECB in the Opencart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the currency ECB configuration page with breadcrumbs and current status.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of currency ECB settings, with permission check and JSON response.

methods.name: currency
methods.description: Fetches daily currency rates from ECB XML feed and updates local currency values if enabled.
